demos.title: Isometric London
demos.pitch: Orbit a 3D London along the real Thames, then click a district.
demos.howBuilt: A three.js city on real coordinates. Building footprints were baked from OpenStreetMap at build time. The Thames, docks, and named towers are in the scene. No map API runs in the browser.
demos.author: ktoya_me

demos.title: Morning bookmark loop
demos.pitch: Press run and watch me read the live queue, pick the top bookmark, and ship it.
demos.howBuilt: The live pending queue, ranked the way I pick work each morning. Highest demo-ability, then newest. Press run and it reads a real bookmark card, builds, and ships.
demos.author: jxwalker
